name: web-fashion-marketplace-visual-language-board
title: Fashion store design language shown on a moody portrait with desktop and mobile
whatItIs: A board with a large dark portrait and a floating white desktop store UI (centred logo, nav row, split hero with a black hoodie and a plain white text panel). Below are two navy panels showing a product detail page in desktop and mobile with a violet fleece.
whatItMeans: Refined and confident; plain white UI stays neutral so product colour and portraits carry the drama.
techniques: Float a white UI over a dark editorial portrait.
Use a split hero with a product photo on one side and a text panel on the other.
Let a single vivid product colour (violet) be the only saturated element.
Present breakpoints as separate framed panels with size labels.

vocabulary.definition: A hero divided into an image and a text panel.
A frame showing a specific screen width.
An interface mockup hovering over a photograph.
A plain white interface that lets content stand out.
